note: Frozen before any HISTORY_UNSEEN or FORWARD candle was fetched or scored. Hash = SHA-256 of the canonical JSON (sorted keys) of EMA_FORWARD_SPEC in src/lib/ema-forward-research.ts.

candidate.origin: Phase 4B benchmark emaAlwaysIn(c4, funding, from, to, COSTS, 50, 200, 1000, 4h); noticed on the Phase 4B locked test, so the Phase 4B window cannot count as evidence
candidate.timeframe: 4h (UTC-aligned aggregation of 1h candles; incomplete buckets dropped, never filled)
candidate.emaSeed: SMA of the first N closes of the fetched series (indicators.ema)
candidate.longShort: both: LONG when EMA50 > EMA200 at the previous 4h close, otherwise SHORT (always in the market once both EMAs exist)
candidate.entry: at the open of the first bar of the segment, and at the next 4h open after the previous close changes direction
candidate.exit: reverse at the next 4h open on a direction change; the open position is closed at the segment's last close
candidate.positionSizing: fixed 1000 USDT notional per position (no compounding, no leverage modelled; quantity = 1000 / entry price)
candidate.fees: taker 0.05 % per side (Binance USD-M regular tier list fee; NOT verified against an account)
candidate.spreadSlippage: spread 0.01 % (half per side) + slippage 0.01 % per side — assumptions, no historical bid/ask data
candidate.funding: actual historical funding rates charged for events strictly inside (entry, exit); at the funding mark price, or the entry price when the exchange supplies no mark
candidate.dataSource: Binance USD-M public GET /fapi/v1/klines (1h) and /fapi/v1/fundingRate; credential-free

sensitivity.note: reported on HISTORY_UNSEEN only; never used to change the candidate

rule.R1: HISTORY_UNSEEN full: >= 30 trades, net expectancy > 0 and t-stat >= 2
rule.R2: HISTORY_UNSEEN train, validation and test each: net > 0 (beats cash); validation and test each >= 8 trades
rule.R3: Walk-forward: >= 60 % of 90-day windows with at least one trade are net positive
rule.R5: At 2x costs, HISTORY_UNSEEN full net expectancy > 0
rule.R6: FORWARD: >= 30 closed trades with net expectancy > 0 (required for anything beyond historical evidence)
rule.verdict: any of R1-R5 fails -> NO TRADE; R1-R5 pass but R6 fails -> INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE; all pass -> CANDIDATE FOR FORWARD-PAPER REVIEW. Every outcome stays RESEARCH_ONLY; none authorizes paper or live trading.
